arStrings.szText: Guided by Lycander, Seer Athrpa embarks on her final attempt to cleanse the Sightless Eye.

Lycander is troubled that we are continuing to meddle with the Eye, but she knows that Athrpa will continue her quest no matter what.

The angel has offered to help us cleanse the Eye with her own blood. To do so, we must find a place where "lovers say farewell." I should meet Athrpa at the Temple of Life to begin our search.
Join Seer Athrpa in the Temple of Life

The angel has offered to help us cleanse the Eye with her own blood. To do so, we must find a place where "lovers say farewell." I should meet Athrpa at the Temple of Life to begin our search.

Seer Athrpa has a lead. She discovered a Firstborn graveyard called the Hollow of Farewells. She thinks this is the place Lycander mentioned, where "lovers say farewell." I must travel there with Athrpa to find out for sure.

Solve the riddle by interacting with the statues

We have found the Vault of Lycander, sealed in the days of the waking world. Perhaps we are the first people to walk in these halls since Philios himself. 

Cleansing the Eye will be no easy feat, and it will require all our strength and focus. Whatever awaits us in this vault, I must do what I can to help Seer Athrpa.

Seer Athrpa glimpsed a dire future in the Eye. An omen of things to come for Sanctuary and its people. It is clear this vision weighs heavy on Athrpa's shoulders, a burden of knowledge she must always carry.
